sentences.en: Are you all right?
Is your brother all right?
You are off color, are you all right?

sentences.fa: مادرت حالش خوبه؟ انگاري رنگش پريده.
sentences.en: Is your mother all right? She seems off color.
I am not all right/ I am down/ I am under the weather. I have got a vomit?
Is anything wrong? You seem off color.

sentences.fa: نمي دونم چي خوردم؟ سرگيجه دارم.
sentences.en: I don't know what I have eaten? I feel dizzy.
Why are you off color?
Is your mother all right? I am worried about her.

sentences.fa: مي بايست تا الان مي رسيد، نگرانشم.
sentences.en: She should have arrived by now, I am worried about mother.

sentences.fa: نگران نباش، احتمالاً تو ترافيک گير کرده.
sentences.en: Don't worry; she must have gotten stuck in the traffic.

sentences.fa: حالم خوب نيست، بدجور معده درد دارم.
sentences.en: I am down, I have got a terrible stomach ache .

sentences.fa: حالم خوب نيست، با رئيسم دعوا کردم.
sentences.en: I am not in the mood, I have quarreled with my boss.

sentences.fa: حالم خوب نيست، سر به سرم نذار.
sentences.en: I am in a rotten mood, don't pull my leg.

sentences.fa: التماست مي کنم، مامانم حالش خوبه؟
sentences.en: I entreat you, is my mother all right?
I beg you.

sentences.fa: مادرم حالش خوبه، اينجا بستري هست.
sentences.en: Is my mother all right? She is bed ridden here.
I am worried about her.
I am getting worried about her.
My mother has been laid up here.

sentences.fa: نگران نباش، سر و مر گنده هست. تازه عملش کردم.
sentences.en: Don't worry; your mother is alive and kicking. I have just operated her.
She has just been operated.
Is your boss all right?

sentences.fa: رو چه حسابي اين حرف رو مي زني؟
sentences.en: What makes you say that?
I am worried about him, he has just had an accident.
He has just had an accident.
He is as strong as an ox.

sentences.fa: خوبي، داره ازت خون مي ره.
sentences.en: Are you all right? You are bleeding.

sentences.fa: نگران نباش، چيزيم نيست، سر و مرو گنده ام.
sentences.en: Don't worry, nothing is wrong with me, I am alive and kicking.

sentences.fa: مادرم حالش خوبه؟ دلم شور مي زنه.
sentences.en: Is my mother all right? I have got a butterfly in my stomach.
What makes you worry about her?
I heard she was bed ridden here.

sentences.fa: متأسفانه، مجبورم بگم من نهايت تلاشم رو کردم.
sentences.en: Unfortunately, I gotta tell you I have done my best.

sentences.fa: من نهايت تلاشم رو ديشب کردم.
sentences.en: I did my best last night.
I have done my best, he is at death's door.
There is nothing wrong with me.

sentences.fa: عملش رو تموم کردم. متأسفانه مجبورم بگم کاري از دستم بر نمي آد.
sentences.en: I have finished her operation. Unfortunately, I gotta tell you there is nothing I can do about it.

sentences.fa: کاري از دستت بر مي آد؟
sentences.en: Is there anything you can do about it?

sentences.fa: کاري از دستم بر نمي آد، دقيقه به دقيقه داره بدتر مي شه.
sentences.en: There is nothing I can do about it; he has been going downhill minute by minute.
What are you worried about?

sentences.fa: تازه عمل شده، دقيقه به دقيقه داره بهتر مي شه.
sentences.en: She has just been operated; she has been going uphill minute by minute.

sentences.fa: مسأله اقتصادي کشور روز به روز بدتر مي شه.
sentences.en: The economical problem of the country has been aggravating day by day.

sentences.fa: متأسفانه، کاري از دستم بر نيومد.
sentences.en: Unfortunately, there was nothing I could do about it.

sentences.fa: کاري از دستت براومد براش انجام بدي؟
sentences.en: Was there anything you could do about it?

sentences.fa: کاري از دستم بر نيومد، زير عمل فوت کرد.
sentences.en: There was nothing I could do about it; she passed away in the operation.
Is your mother all right, I heard she had had an accident.

sentences.fa: نگران نباش، سر و مرو گنده هست. تو اتاقش دراز کشيده.
sentences.en: Don't worry, she is alive and kicking. She is lying in her room.
Are you all right? I heard you had an operation yesterday.

sentences.fa: عمل داشتم، خدا رو شکر. الان سرپا هستم.
sentences.en: I had an operation yesterday, thanks God. I am up and about now.

sentences.fa: مادرت حالش خوب نيست. نياز به تنفس مصنوعي داره.
sentences.en: Your mother is down. She needs a breathe of life.
Have you had a drink?
You are as right as rain.

sentences.fa: دو هفته پيش عمل کردم، الان تو دوران نقاهت هستم.
sentences.en: I had an operation 2 weeks ago; I am on the mend now.
How long have you been bed ridden in the hospital?

sentences.fa: دو هفته است تو بيمارستان بستريم. دکتر قراره فردا مرخصم کنه.
sentences.en: I have been bed ridden in the hospital for 2 weeks. The doctor is supposed to release me tomorrow.

sentences.fa: خوبي؟ چرا هي داري وول مي خوري؟
sentences.en: Are you all right? Why are you moving/struggling over and over?
I need call of nature/take a leak.
I have got a new lease of life.

sentences.fa: چقدر تشنه ام بود، جيگرم حال اومد.
sentences.en: How thirsty I was, I have got a new lease of life.

sentences.fa: مطمئن نيستم. بذار ببينم چي شده؟
sentences.en: I am not sure, let me see what has happened?
Are you all right? Why are you legless?
What happened to you?
What has happened to you?
I think I have broken my leg.
Have you fallen down?
Did you fall down last night?
I saw you fall down last night.
I have just laid her up. There is nothing wrong with her.

sentences.fa: بوسيله يه نفر که سوار اسکيت بود زمين خوردم.
sentences.en: I was knocked down by someone on the roller skate.
I have fallen down.
I fell down last night.

sentences.fa: زمين سر بود، ديشب زمين خوردم.
sentences.en: The floor was slippery, I felt down last night.

sentences.fa: داشتم تو خيابون راه مي رفتم که يهو توسط يه دوچرخه سوار از پشت زمين خوردم.
sentences.en: I was walking along street, when suddenly; I was knocked by someone on a bicycle from behind.

sentences.fa: داشتم تو خيابون راه مي رفتم که توسط يه موتور سوار زمين خوردم و کيف رو دزديد.
sentences.en: I was walking along the street, I was knocked down by someone on a motorcycle, and I was mugged.

sentences.fa: فکر مي کنم پام رگ به رگ شده.
sentences.en: I think I have sprained my ankle.
I have broken my leg.

sentences.fa: داشتم تو خيابون راه مي رفتم، برادرت جفت پا برام گرفت.
sentences.en: I was walking along the street; your brother tripped me up.

B: Well, I am not sure.
B: I was knocked down by someone on the roller skate.
A: Oh, no. Can I do anything to help?
A: Can I help? Shall I call an ambulance?
A: Oh dear. Let me help you up.
B: Thanks. You are very kind.
